description: Current Bitcoin network fee rates in sat/vB for next-block, half-hour, one-hour and economy confirmation, the estimated cost in sats of a typical payment, mempool size and total pending fees, and the latest block height. Use before sending a Bitcoin transaction or to decide whether to wait for lower fees. Costs $0.0002 in USDC on Base per successful call, paid with x402.
name: btc-fees
